Road of Legends

Event
Starts:
Monday, July 6, 2026, at 12:01 AM Local Time
Ends:
Friday, July 10, 2026, at 11:59 PM Local Time

The countdown to Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global starts here! During the Road of Legends, Trainers around the world can gear up for the big weekend with a full week of powerful raid encounters, event bonuses, and GO Pass rewards. Whether you’re looking to strengthen your team, stock up on rewards, or take on some of Pokémon GO’s most formidable foes, this is your chance to get ready for the adventure ahead.

Bonuses

Bonuses active from Road of Legends through Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global

The following bonuses are active from Monday, July 6, through Sunday, July 12, 2026.

No Remote Raid Pass limit Monday, July 6, to Sunday, July 12, 2026
Receive special stickers from spinning PokéStops and opening Gifts
Premier Balls will be more effective at catching Pokémon after raids
Party Power charges faster in raids

The trade bonus for extra Candy XL was removed. The bonus is available from the GO Pass in July.

Bonus active during Road of Legends

The following bonus is active from Monday, July 6, at 12:01 a.m. to Friday, July 10, at 11:59 p.m. local time.

Up to 2 free Raid Passes from spinning Photo Discs at Gyms

Features

New Pokémon Backgrounds Debut!

After catching certain Pokémon from Raid Battles during the Road of Legends and through Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global, Trainers will have a chance to receive Special Backgrounds! These souvenir backgrounds will appear on a Pokémon’s summary page, similar to the Location Backgrounds that are available exclusively at in-person events.

Pokémon caught from five-star raids, Primal Raids, and Mega Raid Battles between July 6 and July 12 may also have a Special Background.

Mewtwo caught from Super Mega Raids during GO Fest: Global may have a Special Background. If that Mewtwo with a Special Background is Mega Evolved, its Mega Evolution’s background will have an additional visual effect.

Super Mega Raids During Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global

Mega Mewtwo X and Mega Mewtwo Y will be featured in Super Mega Raids during Pokémon GO Fest: Global!

Every Mewtwo caught from Super Mega Raids will have at least one Mega Level already unlocked, and it can be Mega Evolved without the initial energy cost! Mewtwo caught from Super Mega Raids will also be more likely to have high Attack, Defense, and HP.

GO Pass

From Monday, July 6, at 12:01 a.m. to Sunday, July 12, at 11:59 p.m. local time, the GO Pass and the GO Pass Deluxe for Road of Legends will be available in Pokémon GO!

Complete Pass Tasks to rank up your GO Pass: Road of Legends to earn the following rewards:

  • Encounters with Pikachu wearing a team hat
  • Candy of Pokémon appearing in Legendary Raids throughout the week
  • GO Fest Tee avatar item
  • Link Charges
  • Incubators
  • Incense
  • Lucky Trinket at Rank 100
  • Bonus increasing your Link Charge cap to 2,000 until Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global

Trainers who upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe can also earn the following additional rewards:

  • Team Leader Pose
  • A Gold Bottle Cap (can be used to max any Pokémon’s stats)
  • Mewtwo with a Special Background at Rank 90
  • Candy XL
  • 2× Hatch Stardust
  • 2× Hatch Candy
  • Additional 5,000 XP from completed raids
  • Additional 3 Candy from completing 5-star and higher raids
  • Additional 1 Candy XL from completing 5-star and higher raids
  • 1/2 Egg Hatch Distance

Each day from July 6 through July 10, a daily Pass Task is available—win a raid to earn 250 Pass Points.

You can also earn up to 1,000 extra points daily by completing certain tasks:

  • Hatch an Egg — 250 PTS
  • Win a raid — 100 PTS
  • Catch a Pokémon — 5 PTS

Every rank rewards the free GO Pass track, while the GO Pass Deluxe adds the premium reward shown on each rank.

GO Pass: Road of Legends

Earn a Lucky Trinket at rank 100! Trainers who upgrade to the Deluxe pass can encounter Mewtwo with a Special Background at rank 90 and a Gold Bottle Cap at rank 100.

Raids

Legendary Pokémon, Ultra Beasts, and other powerful Pokémon will appear in raids throughout the event. Pokémon appearing in five-star raids each day will also be featured in a Raid Hour from 6:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. local time on that day. On Monday, Raid Hour will take place from 6:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m.

Pokémon appearing in Mega Raids each day will also be featured in a Mega Raid Hour from 7:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m. local time on that day. On Friday, there will be a Primal Raid Hour from 7:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m.

Moves

Featured Attacks

Kyurem encountered from raids may know the Charged Attack Glaciate.

  • Kyurem

Origin Forme Palkia encountered from raids may know the Charged Attack Spacial Rend (Adventure Effect).

Origin Forme Dialga encountered from raids may know the Charged Attack Roar of Time (Adventure Effect).

For a limited time, Trainers can use an Elite TM to get Spacial Rend or Roar of Time for Origin Forme Palkia and Origin Forme Dialga respectively during Road of Legends through Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global.

  • Origin Forme Dialga
  • Origin Forme Palkia
